title: Request: one-time PLG eval uplift & testbed SLA variance for ScoutAI
text:
Request: one-time PLG eval uplift & testbed SLA variance for ScoutAI

['From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Cc: Samir Patel <samir@scoutai.com>, Nina Gomez <nina@scoutai.com>
Date: Tue, 8 Sep 2026 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Request: one-time PLG eval uplift & testbed SLA variance for ScoutAI

Team — quick context: ScoutAI is a strategic potential customer (deal attached: DEAL-2026-8479). They’re building inference orchestration into their flagship product and want to run a stretched proof-of-concept for 6 weeks with sustained load (peak 60 rps, steady 30 rps) to validate latency under production concurrency.

Current PLG limits only allow a 2-week eval and a modest usage cap. ScoutAI is asking for a one-time uplift (additional $20,000 in hosted credits) and a 4-week extension (total 6 weeks). They also asked for a temporary SLA variance for testbed throughput (we’d agree to elevated throughput with monitoring and a fall-back plan).

Why this matters: ScoutAI is in active selection vs three competitors and expects to embed Redwood as default runtime if POC proves out. Revenue potential: $750k ARR first 12 months, plus channel intro to two OEM partners.

What I’m asking: can Deal Desk approve a one-off PLG uplift ($20k credits) + 4-week extension and an operational SLA variance limited to the POC window? We’d attach a mutual action plan (attached) and require them to complete the security evidence checklist before uplift.

Attachments: ScoutAI_MAP_v2.pdf, prod-load-plan.csv, security-evidence.zip

Next steps: Ben — I need your short recommendation for pricing/discount guardrails. Aditya — can you confirm that Dedicated capacity will not be required and we can satisfy load on hosted with our burst pools? Laura — flagging for executive sign-off because this exceeds standard PLG authority.

— Jordan
Jordan Blake
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jordan_blake@redwood.com
', 'From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 8 Sep 2026 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: one-time PLG eval uplift & testbed SLA variance for ScoutAI

Jordan — I reviewed the MAP and their projected consumption. Recommendation: approve the $20k hosted credit as a one-time concession tied to the signed MAP and a DocuSign commitment to the evaluation scope. Require a usage cap override that is automatically revoked after 6 weeks. No additional discount to list pricing beyond credits; standard T&Cs apply.

Risk notes: if they try to push for Dedicated capacity during POC, route back — we should keep them on hosted to maintain leverage. Also suggest we require a point-of-contact for load tests and a weekly sync to monitor token consumption and error rates.

— Ben
Ben Carter
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference', 'From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 8 Sep 2026 12:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: one-time PLG eval uplift & testbed SLA variance for ScoutAI

Can confirm: hosted burst pools can handle the proposed 60 rps short peaks for the POC window. Operational asks: we’ll provision a temporary throughput policy, enable prefix caching for repeated prompts, and add an alert channel for error spikes. No Dedicated nodes required unless they exceed sustained 40 rps for more than 3 days.

I’ll coordinate with infra ops to add the monitoring hooks and a fallback to a lower-cost model variant if latency increases beyond our SLO.

— Aditya
Aditya Rao
Director, Platform Engineering | Redwood Inference', 'From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Samir Patel <samir@scoutai.com>, Nina Gomez <nina@scoutai.com>
Date: Wed, 9 Sep 2026 08:17:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Request: one-time PLG eval uplift & testbed SLA variance for ScoutAI

Laura — looping you directly for signoff. Ben and Aditya have provided recommendations and operational feasibility. Key asks for approval: 1) one-time $20k hosted credit; 2) extend PLG eval window to 6 weeks total; 3) short-term SLA variance for throughput limited to that window. We’ll require a filled security checklist and a signed MAP before credits are released.

Samir / Nina — we’ll pause the credit/extension until internal approvals are completed. Appreciate your patience; we expect decision within one business day.

— Jordan', 'From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Cc: Samir Patel <samir@scoutai.com>
Date: Thu, 9 Sep 2026 16:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: one-time PLG eval uplift & testbed SLA variance for ScoutAI

Thanks for the concise packet, Jordan. After reviewing the MAP, revenue motion, and Ben/Aditya notes I approve the one-time $20,000 hosted credit and the 4-week extension (6-week total) on the following conditions: 1) ScoutAI signs the MAP via DocuSign within 7 days (link provided below); 2) security checklist is completed and validated by our security team; 3) we add a clause limiting the uplift to this single occasion for this deal and an automatic rollback of any capacity override at the end of the POC window.

Operationally, Aditya — please implement monitoring and automated fallback as discussed. Ben — coordinate the contractual addendum (one-page SOW amendment) and send DocuSign. Jordan — once the MAP is signed and security verifies the evidence, you may release the credits from Deal Desk.

Laura Bennett
VP, Revenue | Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.com

-----Forwarded Message (for external confirmation)-----
From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir@scoutai.com>, Nina Gomez <nina@scoutai.com>
Date: Thu, 9 Sep 2026 16:46:00 -07:00
Subject: ScoutAI — one-time credit & extension approved pending paperwork

Samir / Nina — good news: Redwood has approved a one-time $20k credit and the requested 6-week eval window, subject to the three conditions Laura listed (signed MAP, completed security checklist, automated rollback). Ben will send the DocuSign MAP shortly. We’ll keep weekly checkpoints with your team.

Jordan Blake
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jordan_blake@redwood.com
